_comment: Masses of everything on this robot that is not a printed part, for the sim mass model. One entry per component. confidence: V = manufacturer/official datasheet, D = distributor spec page, S = derived estimate (reasoning in 'note'). Consumed by sim/tools/build_mass_model.py, which places each item at the position the CAD gives it. NOTHING here has been weighed yet - a kitchen scale beats every S entry, especially cutoff_xycd63, antispark_switch and the LiPo variant.
_petg_note: Bambu PETG 1.27 g/cm3 solid, printed with 4 walls / 40 % gyroid -> ~0.59 of solid. Used for every printed part, including the backpack shells.

feetech_sts3250.note: leg joints; same case as the 3215 but coreless motor, +19.5 g. The model used 62 g until 2026-09-23.

lipo_3s_2200.note: Gens Ace 3S 2200 mAh XT60. Variant not recorded: 168-185 g across the range (higher C-rate ~ +10 g); 180 g is the middle. The 25 mm deep CAD pocket fits the 23-25 mm (45C/60C) bodies. Heaviest single part - weigh it.

raspberry_pi_4b.note: Raspberry Pi Ltd publishes no mass; 46 g is the distributor figure, owners measure 46-47 g.

waveshare_servo_adapter.note: Bus Servo Adapter (A) V1.1, 42 x 33 mm. Waveshare gives no mass; 14-16 g across distributors.

cutoff_xycd63.note: No datasheet for the module. Songle SLA-05VDC-SL-A relay 20 g [V] + FR4 56x62x1.6 mm ~11.5 g + 2 screw terminal blocks ~6 g + display/MCU/passives ~4 g. Distributor weights of 51/71 g look like packaged weights. +-10 g - weigh it.

antispark_switch.source: cross-check: 22.6 g for a cased XT60 electronic switch (amazon B0GXVF2J4G)
antispark_switch.note: Body only: the 22 g of a complete unit minus the XT60 pair counted separately as xt60_pair. PCB ~2.4 g + MOSFETs/cap ~3 g + body/heatshrink ~2 g + stubs. +-8 g.

fuse_holder_30a.source: build-up: ATC/ATO inline holder body ~8 g + 30 A blade fuse ~2.5 g
fuse_holder_30a.note: Holder + fuse only. The XT60s of the inline fuse cable are xt60_pair entries, its wire is in the cable table.

lipo_warner.note: acoustic low-voltage alarm on the balancer port; market range 5-14 g

waveshare_rp2040_lcd_128.note: head IMU board (QMI8658). D 39.5 mm PCB 3.7 g + round IPS glass/backlight/FPC ~3 g + USB-C, battery connector, RP2040/flash/passives ~1.5 g. Waveshare publishes no mass.

pi_camera_module_3.note: PCB 25 x 24 x 1 mm ~1.1 g + lens barrel/AF actuator ~1.5-2 g + 200 mm FPC ribbon ~1.5 g. Raspberry Pi Ltd publishes no mass; 12-14 g quotes are boxed weights.

plug_usb_bundle.source: estimate: USB-A + Ethernet + HDMI plug bodies at the Pi's port side
plug_usb_bundle.note: the plug bodies sitting in the pi_plugs envelope, without their cable (cables are in the cable table)

plug_usbc.source: estimate: moulded right-angle USB-C plug body
plug_usbc.note: 5 V power plug at the Pi

plug_molex_pair.source: estimate: 2 x Molex 5264 3-circuit housing with crimps, ~0.35 g each
plug_molex_pair.note: the two servo-bus plugs on the Waveshare adapter

plug_dc_barrel.source: estimate: 5.5 x 2.1 mm barrel plug, moulded body
plug_dc_barrel.note: 12 V input of the Waveshare adapter

screw_terminal_pair.source: estimate: wire ferrules + screw heads in one terminal block of the cutoff
screw_terminal_pair.note: the metal actually sitting in the VIN / OUT terminal envelopes, on top of the block already counted in cutoff_xycd63

screws_m3_set4.source: estimate: 4 x M3x10 steel (~1.1 g each) + heat-set inserts

servo_harness.source: estimate: ~3.5 m of 3-wire bus cable to 16 daisy-chained servos at ~7 g/m
servo_harness.note: NOT in the CAD: the wiring that runs from the backpack through the torso into the legs and arms. Lumped at the torso centre - it is really spread along the limbs, so it slightly under-weights the legs.

wire._comment: Cable masses: each named run of hardware/backpack_v2/backpack_v4.py CABLES gets a gauge and a conductor count; build_mass_model.py multiplies by the length of its CAD centreline.

awg14_silicone.source: geometry from https://zz-wire.com/index.php?a=show&c=content&id=1066 (400 x 0.08 mm strands, OD 3.5 mm)
awg14_silicone.note: copper 2.011 mm2 -> 18.0 g/m + silicone 6.93 mm2 -> 9.0-9.7 g/m. Model checked against a published 6 AWG figure to within 8 %.

awg18_silicone.source: same geometric model: copper 0.823 mm2 -> 7.4 g/m + silicone jacket ~3 g/m

awg22_pvc.source: same model: copper 0.326 mm2 -> 2.9 g/m + PVC ~1.5 g/m

servo_bus_26awg.source: same model: copper 0.129 mm2 -> 1.16 g/m + PVC 0.73 mm2 -> 1.0 g/m
servo_bus_26awg.note: per conductor of a Molex 5264 3-wire bus cable

usb_cable.source: estimate for a shielded 4-core USB cable
